title: Music Row w Free Parking | Close to University
description:
Perfect location in the HEART of midtown! Inquire us for more discount. 

Free 2 PARKING spots! This 2BR - 2BA condo is in walking distance to:

✔︎ The Frist Museum
✔︎ Belmont University
✔︎ Vanderbilt University
✔︎ Downtown Nashville
✔︎ The Country Music Hall of Fame
✔︎ Hillsboro Village on 21st Avenue for good restaurants and bars
✔︎ Music Row - Hub of Nashville's entertainment industry
 ✔︎ Broadway - where are the honky tonk bars

and many other tourist scenes to check out!

The space
It's a cozy and nicely decorated 2BR, 2 full Bathrooms in a 1000 SQft condo. All the furnishings were carefully picked to make the condo look like a home. 

You can find everything you need for a trip even for a cooking you want as in your home. 

High standard housekeeping service is selected to make the room always clean and organized.

➤ Bedrooms:
- 1 bedroom with a king-sized bed
- 1 bedroom with a queen-sized bed

➤ Living Room:
- Sofa Queen Bed
- 55" Smart TV

➤ Kitchen:
- Refrigerator
- Dishwasher
- Stove
- Microwave
- Hot water kettle
- Coffee maker
- Cookware, Utensils, Dinnerware
- 3-seater dining table for meals

➤Bathrooms:
- Enjoy convenience with 2 ensuite bathrooms, one for each bedroom

➤ Laundry:
- washer and dryer, laundry detergent

Book now for a delightful stay in this condo!

Guest access
You have the entire home, with 24/7 self-check-in.

Detailed instructions will be provided on the day of your arrival for a seamless check-in experience.

✔︎ Fast WiFi 
✔︎ Washer and Dryer
✔︎ Self Check-in 24/7 
✔︎ Free Parking for 2 vehicles

Other things to note
★ INFORMATIONS ★

☆ NO ELEVATOR ☆
This condo building has no elevator, guest must use stairs stairs and it is a 3-story building so please keep in mind as you may have heavy luggages.

☆ LONG TERM STAYS ☆
We encourage every guests who needs a long term stay to choose our home! it is very convenient to most students, work travelers. Long term stay discounts are available.

☆ AMENITIES SUPPLIES ☆
We provide sufficient 7 days amenities supplies. You are required to refill your own supply if it is running out.

☆ FREE PARKING ☆
2 cars can be parked on the parking lot for free.
